purpose: Single intake point for new public-information research hypotheses. FIFO only; no performance/selection authority.
instructions: Append one candidate object to candidates in queue order.
Required fields: id, name, hypothesis, construction, sources, next_gate, cheap_falsifiers, gates.
Construction must encode a frozen deterministic point-in-time/public-observation boundary.
Sources are provenance leads, not scientific evidence. Candidates stay quarantined after successful intake.
Do not add return/drawdown, winner, selection/ranking, tuned-parameter, holdout, promotion, or authorization fields.
The active Q104:I19 / Q220 / Q221 focus is not widened automatically.
